newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom seeks Taiwan mobile phone licence.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom seeks Taiwan mobile phone licence.

text.p: State-owned telecommunications operator France Telecom is part of a consortium applying for a cellular telephone licence in northern Taiwan, France Telecom said on Friday.

France Telecom subsidiary France Telecom Mobiles International (FTMI) holds a 20 percent stake in the Tchang Da International Co consortium bidding for the Taiwanese goverment's tender for a GSM or DCS1800 cellular license.
Its other partners in the consortium are Taiwan-based financial institutions and industrial companies.
France Telecom said the development outlook for mobile telephones in Taiwan is "among the world's most promising".
If licenses are granted, the consortium is committed to opening a network in northern Taiwan in the six months following the agreement, and expects to invest up to one billion francs through 2001.
